name: Islamic Center of Irvine
mission: We strive to build an Islamic community, modeled on the example of the Prophet ﷺ, devoted to exemplifying the highest virtues of character through caring for the spiritual, educational, and material welfare of our neighborhoods. Guided strictly by the Holy Qur’an and the Sunnah, we act with transparency, inclusion, and equity; uphold the 5 pillars of faith; and facilitate the practice, education, and dissemination of information about Islam in the United States of America, so that our unified community may serve as a beacon of compassion, justice, knowledge, and peace.
theoryOfChange: The ICOI Young Professionals program outlines its mission and approach through 'Three pillars guide every program we run: Connect, Grow, Serve.' These pillars detail how the program aims to build authentic friendships and professional networks, foster career and personal development through workshops and mentorship, and create impact through volunteer projects and community initiatives. This framework links their activities to their intended outcomes for young professionals.
